 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have experience supporting the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of cloud-native applications and supporting solutions, and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who supports the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of cloud-native applications and supporting solutions. This position will be  full-time  and  hybrid at Mandaluyong City. 
 What You'll Do 
 Assist in developing and maintaining cloud-native applications and software components

 Support frontend development using Angular and related web technologies

 Support backend development activities using Azure Functions and related services

 Assist in API development and systems integration activities

 Participate in software testing, defect resolution, and quality assurance activities

 Support deployment, release management, and production-readiness activities

 Assist in maintaining development environments and CI/CD pipelines

 Collaborate with business analysts, QA engineers, architects, and senior developers

 Develop and maintain user interfaces, forms, dashboards, and application components

 Support implementation of business logic and backend services

 Work with databases, JSON payloads, and application data structures

 Assist in supporting event-driven integrations and cloud services

 Participate in workflow implementation and automation initiatives

 Follow coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices

 Participate in peer reviews and technical knowledge-sharing activities

 Prepare documentation, implementation notes, and knowledge-transfer materials

 Support stabilization, hypercare, and production support activities

 Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives

 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Knowledge of programming fundamentals and software development principles

 Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern web development concepts

 Familiarity with Angular, React, Vue, or other frontend frameworks

 Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, databases, and application development practices

 Familiarity with Git or version control systems

 Understanding of Agile development concepts (desirable)

 Strong interest in cloud computing and enterprise software engineering

 Strong learning agility and curiosity

 Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability

 Effective written and verbal communication skills

 Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

 Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement

 Preferred:
 Exposure to Microsoft Azure cloud technologies

 Exposure to Azure DevOps and CI/CD concepts

 Familiarity with Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, or similar technologies

 Exposure to databases, APIs, and cloud-native architectures

 Participation in hackathons, coding competitions, open-source projects, or technical communities

 Demonstrated interest in emerging technologies and software engineering best practices

 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions

 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.

 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor

 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
